text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Joking around, aren't you? Atleast that's what I'd like to say, but... that's not the case... You...
text_block_list.orig_text:
冗談よね？
って
言いたいとこだけど……
そうじゃないのよね。
あんたって……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what an idiot.
Idiot, idiot, idiot, idiot...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとばか。
ばか。
ばかばかばかばか……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Can't help it, can I? I'm nothing more than an existence who was never born in another worldline. Just some program's bug. ...And yet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんだ、
しょーがないでしょ？
あたしなんて所詮、
別の世界線じゃ生まれなかった存在。
プログラムのバグなんだから。
……なのに……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: To think you'd... choose someone like me as your Princess. Don't talk nonsense...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そんなあたしを、
プリンセスに選ぶとか。
ばかゆってんじゃ、
ないわよ……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Ngh... L-Look...! I told you before, didn't I? Don't go getting full of yourself. Just because you're a guy, it doesn't mean every single girl is going to fall for you... or anything like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……
あ、
あんたね……
前にゆったけど、
思い上がるんじゃないっての。
オンナノコなら、
誰も彼もあんたに靡くとか……
そんな……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: This is like... yes, a quiz from you to me. The question being "How do you respond to my feelings?"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……これって、
さ。
あんたからの、
クイズみたいなものよね。
「あんたの気持ちに、
あたしがどう応えるか」
って……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
...In that case. I need to give an answer, too.
After all, I've made you give me answers so many times before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なら。
あたしも、
答えを出さなきゃね。
これまでさんざん、
答えさせてきたんだし。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
You...!
D-Don't start counting down on me...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このっ……
カウントすんじゃないわよっ……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, well. It's not bad... I mean...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
そーね。
悪くない……
っていうか……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: I think... I'm actually pretty happy. Of being your Princess...
text_block_list.orig_text:
けっこう、
うれしー、
かも。
あんたの
プリンセス……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
But... you'd better be prepared, you know?
I've got a foul mouth and a nasty personality... and I don't even have a physical body.
Plus, we've got to deal with that "Vision Empress" business first. Not to add how the worldlines are bound to diverge, too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも──
せいぜい、
カクゴしときなさいよ？
あたし
口も性格もワルいし……
現実のカラダもないし。
まずは
幻境竜后
なんとかしなきゃだし。
世界線もバラけるでしょーし……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Even if you come to hate me down the line...
I'll force a "perception correction" on you with all I've got.
...Hehe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしあんたがこの先、
あたしをキライになったとしても
全力で『認識の修正』してやるし。
……ふふっ……

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: I can't really claim to be neutral and equal anymore. After all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう
中立で平等って、
言えないわね
あたし。
だって──

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: You're the number one for me♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたが一番、
なんだもの♪
